name: VNX Gold
oneLiner: VNXAU is VNX's Liechtenstein-licensed gold token where each unit represents one gram of allocated physical gold vaulted under the FMA Blockchain Act.
collateral: Allocated physical gold bars stored in Liechtenstein vaults, with VNX materials describing token-holder ownership and segregated custody
pegMechanism: Each VNXAU represents one gram of gold; verified VNX platform users can sell tokens through the platform and request physical collection or delivery from one-kilogram bar denominations

mintAuthority.summary: VNXAU uses the VNX RBAC architecture with VNXDGR implementation. Mint surface is increaseSupply() gated by onlySupplyControllerRole. VNXManager (0xCdB386...c9AE) is rbacManager; EOA 0x7b0c15...9403 is owner and confirmed sole minter (44 successful increaseSupply calls).

controls.label: VNXAU VNX gold token proxy
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081, EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x1c17d67706423735b8bbf5b234d63b872bd584c4 (VNXDGR contract). Storage slot 0x33 confirms rbacManager = VNXManager 0xCdB3867935247049e87c38eA270edD305D84c9AE. VNXDGR source: increaseSupply(address,uint256) gated by onlySupplyControllerRole which checks rbacManager.hasRole(). 44 increaseSupply() calls (selector 0x79fcd8ee) confirmed successful from EOA 0x7b0c15f39cd987a7d3f5d8d10b57ac6d633e9403.

controls.label: VNXManager RBAC contract
controls.evidence: Shared VNX RBAC manager for all VNX tokens. At block 25295081, owner() = 0x7b0c15f39cd987a7d3f5d8d10b57ac6d633e9403 (confirmed EOA via eth_getCode empty). 2-role RBAC array: role 0 = Superadmin. The same EOA issued all 44 confirmed increaseSupply calls on VNXAU.

controls.label: VNX minter / VNXManager owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081, eth_getCode returns empty (confirmed EOA). This address issued 44 successful VNXAU increaseSupply() calls and owns VNXManager. Issuer-context EOA; off-chain MPC/HSM indistinguishable on-chain, does not block verified.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295081: impl confirmed as VNXDGR 0x1c17d67...; rbacManager at storage slot 0x33 = VNXManager 0xCdB386...c9AE; VNXManager owner() = EOA 0x7b0c15...9403 (eth_getCode empty); 44 successful increaseSupply() calls confirm that EOA as the sole active minter for VNXAU.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VNXAU is an issuer-managed multichain gold token. Reviewed issuer/product sources show multichain issuance and transferability but no independent bridge protocol, so route risk is issuer-native multichain issuance.
